title: The Common Room
summary: Day 3, CONNECTION. Four people in one room and the player is not the subject of any of it, which is the point: the week's first evidence that these people have a life running whether or not you are in it. No mystery content at all. Mandatory because a player who has spent three days alone in the archive has not met the cast, and the rest of Act 1 assumes they have.
